record.question: Who has been named as the goodwill ambassador for the Indian contingent in the Rio-2016 Olympic Games?
record.explanation: Answer A: Salman Khan. Salman Khan was announced as a goodwill ambassador for India's Rio 2016 contingent at the Indian Olympic Association's April 2016 press event. The contemporary original IANS account describes the announcement at IOA headquarters. The role was not necessarily exclusive: other ambassadors were also selected later. Historical/source note: One of the Indian contingent's Rio 2016 goodwill ambassadors; historical appointment supported by attributed original announcement reporting. Reference: https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/sport-others/salman-khan-named-as-indian-contingents-good-will-ambassador-for-rio-olympics-2016-2767016/lite/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
